# Book Loop BD

> Bangladesh's trusted online marketplace for buying and selling second-hand school and college books. Cash on delivery via Steadfast Courier across all 64 districts of Bangladesh.

Book Loop BD (bookloop-bd.lovable.app) helps Bangladeshi students save money on textbooks and recover money from books they no longer need. Sellers list used academic and general books; buyers browse by class, curriculum, condition, or district, place an order, and pay cash on delivery. Every listing and order is reviewed by the platform team before going live.

## What the site is for

- **For buyers**: find affordable used school and college books (Class 1–10, SSC, HSC 1st & 2nd Year, O-Level, A-Level) and general books across genres like self-help, fiction, religion, biography, and more. Pay only on delivery.
- **For sellers**: list books you've finished with, set your own price, and get paid via bKash or Nagad after Steadfast Courier delivers the book.

## Coverage and logistics

- **Curricula**: Bangla Version (NCTB), English Version, English Medium (O-Level, A-Level).
- **Classes**: Class 1 through HSC 2nd Year, plus O-Level and A-Level. University-level books are not supported.
- **Districts**: All 64 districts of Bangladesh.
- **Delivery**: Steadfast Courier nationwide. Cash on delivery only — no prepayment, no online payments.
- **Refunds**: No refunds after successful delivery. Buyers inspect the book at delivery.

## How buying works

1. Browse listings or search by book name, author, class, or genre.
2. Filter by curriculum, condition (New / Good / Fair / Worn), district, or price.
3. Open a listing to see photos, condition, price, and seller's district.
4. Click Order Now, confirm delivery address and the cash-on-delivery amount.
5. The team reviews the order, then Steadfast picks up the book from the seller and delivers it to you.
6. Pay the courier in cash on delivery.

## How selling works

1. Sign up and add your bKash or Nagad number plus address in your profile.
2. Click Sell, upload up to 3 photos, set the condition, class level or genre, and your asking price.
3. The team reviews and approves your listing (you'll get an email notification).
4. When a buyer orders, the team schedules a Steadfast pickup from your location.
5. After delivery, you receive your payment via bKash or Nagad. A flat 10% platform fee is added on top of your asking price for the buyer.
6. Listings stay live for 60 days, with a reminder before expiry.

## Trust and safety

- Every listing is reviewed by an admin before going live.
- Every order is reviewed before pickup is scheduled.
- Steadfast Courier handles all physical handling of books.
- Listings cannot be edited after submission, ensuring buyers see what was approved.
- No user-to-user messaging — all communication runs through the platform.
